title: LC-MS feature detection and peak integration
zh_title: LC-MS 特征检测与峰积分
summary: Build mass traces, detect chromatographic signals, and inspect the boundaries, baseline, sampling, and numerical rule behind an integrated area.
zh_summary: 建立质量轨迹、检测色谱信号，并检查积分面积背后的边界、基线、采样与数值规则。

title: Cross-run alignment and feature correspondence
zh_title: 跨运行对齐与特征对应
summary: Separate time-coordinate correction from matching, inspect ambiguous groups, and distinguish signal-based gap filling from identification and imputation.
zh_summary: 区分时间坐标校正与匹配，检查有歧义的分组，并区分基于信号的缺峰回填、鉴定和统计插补。

title: Spectral library search: from query to defensible match
zh_title: 谱库检索：从待查谱图到可辩护的匹配
summary: Build a reproducible small-molecule MS/MS search, inspect competing hits, and distinguish exact matches from analog hypotheses.
zh_summary: 构建可复现的小分子串联质谱检索，检查竞争候选，并区分同一化合物匹配与类似物假说。

title: Molecular networking: read connections as evidence
zh_title: 分子网络：把连接读成证据
summary: Understand spectrum and feature nodes, build interpretable MS/MS edges, and separate structural relationships from ion-identity links.
zh_summary: 理解谱图节点与特征节点，构建可解释的 MS/MS 连边，并区分结构相关性与离子身份连接。

title: Missing-data handling
summary: Audit unavailable measurements, distinguish re-extraction from imputation, and test how missing-data assumptions change the answer.
zh_summary: 核查不可获得的测量，区分信号再提取与插补，并检验缺失数据假设怎样改变答案。

title: Differential-abundance analysis
summary: Define a design-aware contrast, calculate fold changes and uncertainty, and apply multiple-testing adjustment to an explicit hypothesis family.
zh_summary: 定义符合实验设计的对比，计算倍数变化及不确定性，并针对明确的假设集合进行多重检验校正。
